facts.allowed_use: Use only as external replication evidence after model design; do not expose target-year PSRC labels to NHTS prior generation.

facts.evidence_summary: A fixed ACS-derived remote-work suppression factor improves PSRC 2017+2019 to 2023 transfer, supporting the event-adaptation principle on independent household microdata.
